Both raise their arms upward in a coordinated ballet pose, with the instructor (R1) guiding the movement from behind. The young girl (R2) looks up toward her raised hands in profile, while the instructor (R1) focuses forward. Soft, natural light fills the space, casting gentle shadows against a neutral background with a shallow depth of field.
